Open the repository in the browser

Confirm the installation in the system dialog.
To install ports, allow Recompa to install unknown apps.
This port is installed with a signature the catalog does not know; Recompa will not update it.
This port installs as the same app as %1$s, which you have installed. Uninstall that one first to install this one; its saves may be lost.
Pick the app for this port that you installed outside Recompa. If it is the same app as the repository\'s, Recompa can update it.
There are no apps to link.
This does not look like the same app

“%1$s” does not match the app in the %2$s repository: its package or signature is different. It may be another build of the game or a different app, so Recompa cannot update it.\n\nDo not uninstall it expecting Recompa to install the same app: it may not be, and you could lose your saves.
You linked this app by hand, but it does not look like the one in the repository. Recompa will not update it.
Could not download the APK. Check your connection.
The downloaded file is not a valid APK.
Not enough space to install the port.
Android blocked the installation. If the port\'s developer is not verified by Google, allow installing unverified apps in the system settings.
A build of this port with another signature is already installed. Uninstall it first (saves may be lost).
This port is not compatible with your device.
The catalog has no SHA-256 for this APK, so Recompa will not install it.
The downloaded APK does not match the catalog. It was not installed.
The downloaded APK is a different app (%1$s). It was not installed.
The APK is signed by someone other than expected. It was not installed.

Recompa could not confirm that this APK is the one in the catalog. Often the developer just replaced the file of the release, but it could also be another app or a tampered one. Install it only if you trust where it comes from.

Android only installs this build after removing the one you have, because it is signed with another key or is older. Uninstalling deletes the port\'s data, including any saves kept inside the app, so back up what you want to keep first. Recompa installs the new build once the old one is gone.
Installed apps with their package and signing certificate SHA-256. Tap one to copy the lines for the port manifest.
Pick your copy of the file. Recompa checks that it is the right version and prepares it for the port.
The catalog does not know yet which versions this port accepts, so the file could not be checked. Prepared as %1$s.
This file is not a version the port accepts.
This port needs the file uncompressed. Unzip it and pick the file inside.
The ZIP has no usable file in it.
The file could not be read or saved.
Save it anywhere (for example in Downloads) and pick it from the port when it asks.
Pick the %1$s folder in storage (create it if it does not exist).
A new version of Recompa is available: %1$s
Recompa installs native Android game ports and keeps them up to date. It downloads each port from its author\'s page and checks its signature before installing it.
Games are not included: when a port needs your files (a ROM, the game data), Recompa helps you prepare them from your own copy.
To install ports, Android will ask you to allow Recompa to install unknown apps.
Recompa runs full screen and as Android\'s home screen. Then pick Recompa in Choose home app.
Checks twice a day whether Recompa or your ports have a new version and tells you with a notification.
You stayed on %1$s. Update all will leave this port alone.
The installed version (%1$s) was withdrawn from the catalog. Update or go back to an earlier one.
The installed version (%1$s) was withdrawn from the catalog: %2$s. Update or go back to an earlier one.
This version is older than the installed one and Android won\'t install it on top. Uninstall the port first (you may lose saves) and try again.
If an update breaks something, you can go back to an earlier version. Recompa checks its signature just like the latest.
Nobody has reported how this port runs yet.
Opens a GitHub form with the port and your device filled in. You need a GitHub account.
Missing a port? Paste the link to its GitHub repository. We\'ll review it and, if it fits, add it to the catalog for everyone.
GitHub will open with the suggestion filled in: you only have to submit it. You need a GitHub account.
That doesn\'t look like a GitHub repository. Use a link like https://github.com/owner/repository.
No GitHub account needed. Reports show up here right after they\'re sent.
Performance, glitches, settings you had to change…
Thanks! Your report is already counted.
Thanks! We\'ll review your suggestion soon.
GitHub doesn\'t know that repository. Check the link and that it\'s public.
Couldn\'t send it. Check your connection and try again.
Too many messages from this connection. Try again in a minute.
On devices with two screens, like the AYN Thor, the other screen shows the selected port, your downloads and help with its files, and the catalog\'s art when idle.
Pick your copy on the main screen. Recompa checks that it is one of these versions.
Changes how the library and port pages look, not only the colours.
Cover grid with the selected port beside it.
The selected port in big, rows of tiles per platform.
Alphabetical list with a large preview.
Neon cabinet: a wheel of covers in pixel type.
Flat tiles of different sizes and a menu in large type.
Game boxes on a lit shelf, turned in 3D.
There is more than one port of this game. They share this page, but each one has its own releases and reports. The recommended one has the best reports.
